title: Cyrus and the Echo
author: A. M. Iversen
blurb: Emrys Yarrow, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
